title: Conjecture C*: x-only interpolation degree is N − 1 − O(1) generically
question: Conjecture C*: outside structured families (e.g. CM j = 0 anomalous), the minimal degree of g with g(x(kP)) = k (or k^2) on 1 <= k <= N is N − 1 − O(1); deficits occur with frequency ~1/p (independent-vanishing model). Observed: 154,288 cases (p <= 997), max deficit 3.
